remarks: A Blank Canvas in Glendale Oaks: Fireplace, Two Balconies, Your Vision    Bring your vision to Glendale Oaks! Unit 210 is a true blank canvas: 1,225 sq ft with two bedroom suites, each with its own full bath, plus a cozy den, a rarity in this building, ready to become a home office, reading nook or creative studio. A gas fireplace, central air and two balconies for morning coffee or evening breezes complete the picture. Dated and unrehabbed, with no modernization in about 35 years, this contractor's special awaits your finishes, flooring and fixtures.
